headline: Approved edits to Protect Act draft policy, removing political references, and advanced it for a first reading.
summary: The district must update its policies to match the 2026 Protect Act. Members agreed to strike the opening preamble and political references, including one naming Governor Healey.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 26, 2026 meeting, 2-0.
Approved edits to the Protect Act draft policy and forwarded it for a first reading, 2-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Review: Approval of the minutes from the Policy Subcommittee meeting held on August 26, 2026. ... Vote: Unanimously approved (Cornell – Yes, Stott – Yes).

Motion on Draft Policy: Accept the discussed edits to the Protect Act draft policy and forward it to the full School Committee for a first reading. ... Vote: Unanimously approved (Cornell – Yes, Stott – Yes).
